scenicChapters.title: Sani Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: For 52 km this is Sani Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Sani Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2876 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

sani-pass.story: 71 km one way from Himeville - plan on about 1 h 13 of riding. It goes by way of Sani Pass lower control and Sani Pass. The highest point is about 2,900 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
